page.overview:
Who is Beowulf Cadmus?

Beowulf Cadmus, also known as Beowulf Kadmas, is a secret character from Final Fantasy Tactics. A former captain of the Gryphon Knights of Lionel, he is searching for his fiancée, Reis Duelar.

Beowulf's default job is the templar, allowing him to cast mystic spells instantly while wielding a sword. He can be recruited in the sidequest "Secrets Beneath Goug" in chapter 4, "In the Name of Love".

Beowulf and Reis's story is expanded in The War of the Lions; while these events are mentioned in The Ivalice Chronicles, they are not depicted on-screen.

Beowulf was born as the second son of House Cadmus, an aristocratic family in service to Lionel's territory. As he would not inherit the barony, he left home at a young age to join the Gryphons Knights where Beowulf reached the rank of captain, and was consequently admired by his men. During this period, he became friends with his lieutenant, Aliste Rosenheim, considering him a rival and the only one with skills equal to his own. Beowulf fell in love with Reis Duelar, whom he had known since childhood. The two were engaged, but Celebrant Bremondt Freitberg was also infatuated with Reis and would do anything for her love. He saw Beowulf as an obstacle and tried to dispose of him.
